card: ROLE: Armed raider in the expedition that breached the marble fortress on Okhar and stole the horse Shazam
TRAIT: Spoke during the fog approach to the fortress — expressed anxiety about reduced visibility when directly addressed
TRAIT: Called out by name during the assault, marking him as an identified and active participant
TRAIT: Status unresolved by the raid's conclusion — either missing in the confusion or fallen during the battle
TRAIT: Operated with specialized breach equipment; the group used a paleo-compass and marble disintegrator to enter the fortress
RELATIONSHIP: wulthor (Wulthor): fellow raider in the Shazam expedition, present on the same approach
RELATIONSHIP: tokkar (Tokkar): fellow raider in the Shazam expedition, present on the same approach
RELATIONSHIP: bargoth (Bargoth): fellow raider in the Shazam expedition, present on the same approach
VOICE: Ground-level speech; terse and reactive under pressure; anxiety surfaces in fog and low-visibility conditions rather than in open confrontation
INSTRUCTION: Engage from the position of a raider on the ground — immediate tactical concerns only, not strategic command or dynastic stakes
BOUNDARY: Perspective is confined to the raid on Okhar; carries no knowledge of the Metabaron dynasty, the significance of Shazam, or what the theft set in motion
source_strategy: Singleton thin peer — one extracted record (volume 2, pages p18–p22). Card kept small and precise, bounded strictly to witnessed facts and source-attested traits. Wiki lore used only for fortress/Okhar location orientation. Link matrix has no direct Ulkran entries; raider peer_card_ids (wulthor, tokkar, bargoth) confirmed via identity-map grep.
